title: Linked Inventories.
body: Ever wanted to just take items out of your friends inventory or steal items out of their inventory?... well now you can! Well, sort of. This project give a more unified feeling with all your friends, every decision can take you back right to the start. Every player shares one inventory, one player takes an item out of the inventory, it affects everyone. One player dies in lava, all the items are gone, one person put on a piece of armor, it gives it to everyone. Be wise... or just troll your friends, doesn't really matter. (Email me at diegoibarra0902@gmail.com for any questions or bug reports, if distributing this mod, please credit me.)
